mapper.select: SELECT id, setting_key, setting_value, update_time FROM site_setting ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO site_setting (setting_key, setting_value, update_time) VALUES (#{settingKey}, #{settingValue}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE setting_value = VALUES(setting_value), update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT setting_value FROM site_setting WHERE setting_key = #{key} LIMIT 1
